description:
crate-jmap-sharing-server/Cargo.toml:21-28 introduces the realistic-demo-ids feature with an extensive comment ('Both modes are explicitly demonstration-quality; production backends must mint real ULIDs') and matching rustdoc on demo_next_id at memory.rs:175-192 ('NOT A PRODUCTION PATTERN'). The feature is off by default, gated on a single function's body, and the function itself is named 'demo_next_id' (the rename per bd:JMAP-x2gd.66 is the cargo-cult mitigation).

Why this should be defended: a contributor reading the rendered crate docs might say 'drop the feature gate, just pick one mode and remove the cfg' or 'rename it next_id since it's the only id minter'. Both moves erode the cargo-cult protection:
  1. Single-mode without feature: a downstream copy-paster has no visible signal that the function is demo-grade.
  2. Renaming demo_next_id → next_id: identifiers like next_id read as 'I am the standard id minter, copy me'. Identifiers like demo_next_id read as 'I am the demo impl, do not copy me'.

The two-mode + feature-gate + verbose-rustdoc + suspicious-name combination is the workspace's cargo-cult defense pattern at maximum strength. The associated open beads (bd:JMAP-qz9v.14, bd:JMAP-826m.18, bd:JMAP-qz9v.47, bd:JMAP-qz9v.46, bd:JMAP-ayoz.20, bd:JMAP-x2gd.63) propose various improvements — but the high-level shape should not be weakened on the path to fixing them.
notes: Existing design defended — no code change needed. The realistic-demo-ids feature gate, the demo_next_id name, the dual-mode body with extensive cargo-cult-warning rustdoc, and the 'NOT A PRODUCTION PATTERN' header collectively form the workspace's cargo-cult defense pattern at maximum strength. This bead pre-emptively rejects a 'simplify the feature gate away' or 'rename to next_id' suggestion. (The separate .5 / bd:JMAP-qz9v.14 / bd:JMAP-826m.18 follow-ups address the deeper meta-question of whether the canonical mail-server should adopt this defense or whether sharing-server should revert to uuid — those are workspace-architectural decisions deferred to a sibling sweep.)
title: Cargo.toml realistic-demo-ids feature is gated, defaulted off, and documented as demo-only
